items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Controls: Click=walk, Shift+click=run, Ctrl+C=crouch, Z=grab (alt to Ctrl+click), Space=honk (opens menu if menu not open), X=flap, scroll/A=zoom out, S=zoom in, Tab=no effect. Pickup: Position cursor on object, then Ctrl+left-click OR use Z key. Walking drops held items. Controls menu: Opens unexpectedly during gameplay. Close by clicking above menu area at top of screen (~y=0.05) OR clicking topmost green page indicator at (0.196,0.215) - inconsistent reliability.

Completed: GET INTO GARDEN task.

Current state: Goose mobile in garden center area, standing on dirt path near wooden stile. Tutorial message about pickup (Ctrl+click) persists permanently as guidance. Space key just pressed - honk attempted but no visible effect yet.

Locations: Garden contains: wooden stile/bench (center), stone walls, tree trunk with rocks (left), purple flowers (far right through fence), orange mushrooms (bottom left ~0.32,0.565), yellow-green striped ball (bottom center ~0.35,0.71), brown dirt paths, gray/brown rocks scattered, hedge, tree stump (right side).

Verified mechanics: Pickup works reliably - hover cursor over object, then Ctrl+click. Goose picks up items in beak. Walking (left-click destination) automatically drops held items. Movement responsive but sometimes subtle/constrained by terrain. Controls menu opens unexpectedly, closes inconsistently.

Failed: Tab key never reveals task list. Zoom (scroll) has minimal/no visible effect.

Successful pickups: Orange mushroom (multiple times), yellow-green striped ball (once). All dropped when walking afterward.

Unresolved: Garden objectives unknown - no task list accessible. Tutorial message permanent, not completion-dependent. Honk effect unknown. Purpose of pickable items unclear. No NPCs or interactive structures discovered yet.
